scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && npx esbuild src/index.tsx --bundle --format=esm --jsx=automatic --loader:.woff2=file --external:node:fs --external:node:path --external:node:os --outfile=dist/sidebar.js && cp -r extension/* dist/ && cp -r src dist/
scripts.test: rm -rf dist/tests && npx esbuild tests/*.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --packages=external --format=esm --jsx=automatic --outdir=dist/tests && node --test dist/tests/*.test.js
